item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-c37cb23ad09e8935","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"An ILO baseline review found that Egypt's legal and policy framework provided a basis for refugees' access to work, livelihoods, training, self-employment, business development, social protection, and freedom of association, but it examined implementation through literature review and fieldwork conducted from November 2021 to January 2022.","question_ids":["6B.8","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Contextual pre-2023 evidence; not a finding limited to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"No direct attribution to el-Sisi; concerns national policy and implementation during his presidency.","limitations":["The supplied extract does not report 2023 outcomes or identify presidential decisions." ]},{"source_id":"SRC-1183a9c0bbdee7ae","start_unit":5,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"World Bank WITS reported Egypt's 2023 trade indicators as a Hirschman-Herfindahl market-concentration index of 0.04, export-market penetration index of 0.04, world growth of 0.04%, and Egypt country growth of -9.03%; it also reported 2023 service imports of about $22.006 billion, service exports of $33.649 billion, imports of goods and services equal to 21.34% of GDP, and exports equal to 19.11% of GDP.","question_ids":["5B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly reports 2023 indicators, although the page notes that source years vary and the figures are not necessarily attributable to presidential decisions.","ruler_attribution":"No direct attribution to el-Sisi; these are national trade and macroeconomic indicators during his rule.","limitations":["The extract does not establish causation, policy responsibility, distributional effects, or whether figures are final and comparable across indicators."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1183a9c0bbdee7ae","start_unit":9,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"World Bank WITS reported Egypt's 2023 population as 98,423,595, GDP as $395.926 billion, GNI per capita as $3,840, and trade balance as -$8.862 billion.","question_ids":["5B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly reports 2023 indicators.","ruler_attribution":"No direct attribution to el-Sisi; the figures describe national outcomes during his rule.","limitations":["The extract does not provide a baseline, causal attribution, or distributional analysis."]},{"source_id":"SRC-870a9d111d59136a","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"On 19 October 2023, el-Sisi and U.S. President Biden agreed that humanitarian aid would enter Gaza through the Rafah crossing sustainably, with Egyptian and U.S. authorities coordinating with international humanitarian organizations under United Nations supervision.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.9","3B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"Directly attributed to el-Sisi through the Egyptian Presidency's account of his call and agreement with Biden.","limitations":["The extract records the agreement but not the quantity delivered, duration of implementation, or subsequent compliance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0fac47073bb81532","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Construction of Egypt's El Dabaa nuclear power plant was progressing under a four-unit Russian-supplied project; unit 3 first concrete was poured in May 2023, while the project planned operation of all four units by 2031 and aimed for nuclear power to provide 9% of Egypt's electricity by 2030.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.3","1B.7","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The extract was published in 2024 but reports a concrete 2023 construction milestone and project plans.","ruler_attribution":"The project is a national policy associated with el-Sisi's government, but the extract does not quote or identify a presidential decision in 2023.","limitations":["The extract does not evaluate operational safety, independent oversight, financing risks, or whether the 2030/2031 targets were achieved."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ea3e8f4220ed5e7c","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Egypt's nuclear regulator issued a construction licence for El Dabaa unit 3 on 31 March 2023 after a comprehensive site inspection from 11 to 17 March; the regulator and project authority stated that licensing documents met regulatory requirements and nuclear-safety standards.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.7","1B.10","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct 2023 regulatory decision and inspection.","ruler_attribution":"The action was taken by the Egyptian Nuclear and Radiological Regulatory Authority and Nuclear Power Plants Authority; the extract does not directly attribute the licensing decision to el-Sisi.","limitations":["The extract reports institutional claims and does not provide an independent assessment of regulator independence, enforcement after licensing, or safety performance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f14d6cbbb0fc1bf4","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 30 October 2023, Egypt's House of Representatives approved a draft law establishing an independent-personality National Council for Childhood and Motherhood. The proposed council was assigned national planning, policy monitoring and evaluation, data collection, training, complaint handling, judicial assistance, emergency relief coordination, legislative advice, and an annual budget and internal administrative authorities.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.6","6B.8","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct 2023 legislative approval; the extract describes the law's intended authorities rather than later implementation.","ruler_attribution":"The parliamentary account links the bill's objectives to the national human-rights strategy launched by the president, but it says the bills were submitted by legislators and does not state that el-Sisi personally initiated them.","limitations":["Approval of the draft law does not establish enactment, funding, staffing, independence, or achieved child and maternal outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-55e322e39eb3dfcb","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"An Egyptian Initiative for Personal Rights analysis published on 28 March 2023 reported that currency devaluations, austerity, reduced public spending, higher service prices, and debt-linked economic policy contributed to severe inflation; it reported consumer-price inflation at a five-year high in February and core inflation at 40%, while noting that poor households spent about 47% of expenditure on food.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly published in 2023 and describes conditions affecting the period.","ruler_attribution":"The analysis attributes the policy mix to the Egyptian government in coordination with the IMF, placing it within el-Sisi's governing period but not documenting his personal decision on each measure.","limitations":["This is an advocacy organization's analysis; the extract does not provide a full counterfactual or independently adjudicated causal estimate."]},{"source_id":"SRC-55e322e39eb3dfcb","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The same 28 March 2023 analysis reported that the government raised the minimum wage, increased pensions, raised the tax-exemption threshold, and increased Takaful and Karama pensions, but judged these measures insufficient to protect millions from deprivation of food, education, health care, and other basic rights.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly reported 2023 policy measures and assessment.","ruler_attribution":"The measures are attributed to the Egyptian state during el-Sisi's presidency; the extract does not specify which were personally ordered by him.","limitations":["The extract does not quantify program coverage, budget execution, or the number of people protected."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-d6f0001ae63bb648","SRC-11dc9c1b669ac7a0","SRC-71705e77af8f94fb","SRC-5029ce081eccb3c3","SRC-3ac523dc425e3d42"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents concern periods outside 2023 or provide general background rather than ruler-period evidence.","No supplied source provides direct evidence for many integrity, electoral, media, detention, anti-torture, or corruption lenses during 2023."]}
